title: Stationary C² submanifolds have zero mean curvature (Simon 5.5(2), ⇒)
statement: Assume (TH) and FirstVariation (the contract's first variation formula, Simon 5.3). (TH) is the frozen statement of the sibling root.submanifold_tangent-a1, taken as an explicit hypothesis: (TH1) for every Simon local representation (V, W, ψ) of class r ≥ 1 of any M ⊆ ℝᴺ, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x) for x ∈ V; (TH2) every n-dimensional C^r Simon submanifold of ℝᴺ is a measurable set on which y ↦ tangentProjection M y is continuous. Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} an n-dimensional C² Simon submanifold and U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open with IsStationaryIn n M U. Then meanCurvature M y = 0 for every y ∈ M ∩ U (no compactness assumption on closure U ∩ M is needed).
lean_statement: ((∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) ∧ ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → MeasurableSet M ∧ ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M) → FirstVariation → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) 2 M → IsOpen U → IsStationaryIn n M U → ∀ y ∈ M ∩ U, meanCurvature M y = 0
